title: PREMARKET LIVE: The Trading Floor | TSM Earnings + PPI Data Release
speaker: Arete Trading host

macro_themes.view: PPI and core PPI came in far above consensus, highest readings since 2022; the Fed has no choice but to raise rates.
Money is rotating out of tech/growth into energy, utilities, staples and cash-flowing non-tech; growth vs value (VUG/VTV) is imploding.
Anthropic data was bad, CoreWeave is the poster child of data-center problems, and mega-cap tech like Meta is next to get smoked.
Yields will come in hard as people worry and rotate into treasuries, so buying treasuries and rate-sensitive housing names makes sense.

calls.condition: If QQQ loses 720, 712 is on the table; 725 put wall likely acts as a bounce magnet/level
calls.reason: Gap fill into the 725 put wall; 4-hour RSI around 15 is deeply oversold so sharp snapback bounces are likely, but within a downtrend and he is not buying tech.
calls.quote: if you lose 720, you're looking at 712. I I just think with a 725 put wall that at some point you're setting up to have some kind of bounce

calls.reason: Oversold on the 4-hour RSI after rejecting the October area; shorts must be quick as snapback rallies can be vicious; SPY relatively stronger than QQQ.
calls.quote: this is not an area where you get like short for super long term... the snapback rallies in situations like this can be pretty darn vicious

calls.condition: Watch how semis act at the 500 put-wall level today; that is paramount
calls.reason: Gapping down into the semis put wall at 500 and starting to bounce off it.
calls.quote: watch how you act in that 500 level today. That is going to be paramount to everything

calls.reason: Higher crude plus falling shipping costs means integrated oil companies will print cash; energy chart setting up to rip. He holds an integrated position.
calls.quote: this is setting up to just like rip everybody's face off

calls.reason: With rates likely to rise, money chases yield into utilities; expects a break of the downtrend line. He started buying utilities.
calls.quote: utilities are really setting up to to rip here. I think they're going to break this DTL

calls.reason: CoreWeave is the poster child of data-center problems (15% bonds); currently short, though warns of short-squeeze bounces.
calls.quote: I'm currently short this, but to me, yeah, I think there's some real issues out there with the data center side

calls.reason: No flight to safety into the dollar; mega-cap tech like Meta is next to get smoked; he dumped most swing tech last Thursday.
calls.quote: the metas of the world, um you know, these names got to get smoked and I think that's next

calls.condition: Wants a bounce first to start shorting
calls.reason: SpaceX direct-to-cell news is a major problem for ASTS; down $15 since the news.
calls.quote: who's going to go under is ASTS... I think this is going a lot lower

calls.reason: Super-long-term holding he will never sell even if cut in half, though notes Nvidia is becoming a lender for chip purchases.
calls.quote: the super long-term Nvidia, it can go to 100. I'm not getting out of it. Like I'll just hold it forever

calls.reason: Expects people to worry about rate hikes and rotate into bonds, pushing yields down hard; treasuries, Rocket and homebuilders worth looking at.
calls.quote: I think buying treasuries now makes a lot of sense... Yields are going to drop

calls.reason: New CEO is wielding Berkshire's cash aggressively like a sword (e.g. Bending Spoons stake); makes a ton of sense to get involved longer term.
calls.quote: I actually think that this makes a ton of a ton of sense right now to to look at um and to get involved with from a longer-term perspective

calls.reason: Says he would not go near AMD in this environment.
calls.quote: AMD, I wouldn't go near. These are just notes from before. I wouldn't go near this

notes: No date spoken; PPI-release day, approx_date used. 'Socks' = semis index, quoted level 500 (likely SOXX); ticker SOXX used. Visa, Mastercard, Lilly called 'fantastic' charts but he is not chasing; Walmart/Costco/XLP defensive mentions not recorded. 'Nvidia can go to 100' read as willingness to hold through a drop, not a target.
